subject: EOQ credit request: Helios Systems trial extension & conversion credit
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: EOQ conversion credit for Helios Systems (trial extension + promo)

Ben / Karthik —

Quick context: Helios (Avery Brooks) is on a 30-day POC that shows good signal for NLU routing and embeddings-based search. They’ve hit token limits in the last 48 hours; procurement has signaled that a short runway and a modest conversion incentive will unlock a CFO-level contract conversation. The ask from the field: 60-day trial extension + $10,000 usage credit applied at conversion (not refundable).

Numbers and rationale attached (helios-usage-estimate.csv). My recommended structure: 60-day extension, $10k credit applied as invoice credit on first paid invoice, 12-month minimum commitment required to unlock the credit. No SLA exceptions requested.

Why this is worth it: forecasted ARR from Helios in year 1 is ~ $120k if they convert; they’ve accelerated evaluation and are live in two product lines. Worst case we extend the trial and they decline — $10k upside to close vs lost momentum.

Asking for sign-off to offer the credit and for Finance to confirm billing/PO constraints. If approved I’ll prepare a quote + DocuSign and loop procurement.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
pri.yom (ext 456)

Attachments: helios-usage-estimate.csv, proposed-conversion-plan.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOQ conversion credit for Helios Systems (trial extension + promo)

Priyom — good write-up. I’m okay with a credit to keep momentum but want two guardrails: 1) cap any single-customer credit to $10k for this motion, 2) credit applied only after a signed contract with the 12-month minimum in place (no retroactive cash refunds).

Please confirm the wording we’ll attach to the quote that enforces the minimum term and the credit application mechanics. Assuming Legal/Finance thumbs up, proceed.

—Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts

On tone: keep the public-facing language simple ("$10,000 usage credit applied to first invoice upon execution of a 12-month agreement").

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-26T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOQ conversion credit for Helios Systems (trial extension + promo)

Thanks for the detail. Finance can approve a $10k invoice credit contingent on receiving: a PO referencing DEAL-2027-0913 or a signed order form via DocuSign, and a 12-month committed MRC or one-time annual prepay on record. We’ll need billing code and GL mapping from Priyom when you generate the quote.

Also note: if Helios pays via procurement with delayed payment terms >60 days, we’ll need revenue recognition check — I can clear that once we see payment terms on the PO.

Monica
Finance — Revenue Operations

Attachment: sample-credit-clause.txt (please include in quote)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-26T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOQ conversion credit for Helios Systems (trial extension + promo)

Giving final approval to offer the 60-day extension + $10k conversion credit under the conditions Ben and Monica outlined. Priyom — please create the quote with: clear credit clause (credit applied to first invoice after execution), 12-month term language, and the standard refund/termination language. Loop Legal if you change the clause language.

Action items for you:
- Generate Q-quote in Salesforce/HubSpot, include sample-credit-clause.txt
- Send DocuSign order form to Avery + procurement@helios-sys.com
- Confirm GL code to Monica (use GL-4103 - Trials & Credits)

Karthik
Head of Sales — Enterprise

P.S. Put a 30-day internal follow-up reminder in the deal to verify usage post-extension.

From: Avery Brooks <avery.brooks@helios-sys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, procurement@helios-sys.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-28T15:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: EOQ conversion credit for Helios Systems (trial extension + promo)

Priyom / Ben — thank you, that sounds reasonable and appreciated. Helios accepts the 60-day extension + $10k usage credit conditional on the 12-month term; procurement will route the PO and we’ll execute the order form via DocuSign. Please send the quote and order form so procurement can process it (they require an itemized quote and our standard PO reference).

Next steps from our side: I’ll have procurement@helios-sys.com send the PO referencing DEAL-2027-0913 and confirm payment terms (likely Net 30). Please also include the credit clause language so it’s explicit in the order form.

Looking forward to closing — Avery
Avery Brooks
Director, Platform Engineering, Helios Systems
